# Hygeia Power Wash Solutions

> Premier commercial pressure washing, residential power washing, and monthly curbside trash bin sanitizing in Silicon Valley and the San Francisco Peninsula, California.

Hygeia Power Wash Solutions is a specialized exterior cleaning division of the Hygeia family of facilities services (serving Silicon Valley since 1991). Hygeia specializes in high-temperature 200°F thermal pressure washing, EPA-compliant wastewater reclamation, multi-level parking garage maintenance, dumpster pad degreasing, retail sidewalk restoration, residential flatwork/soft washing, and automated curbside trash can sanitizing subscriptions.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Commercial Pressure Washing](https://hygeiapowerwash.com/commercial-pressure-washing.html): Multi-level parking garages, trash compactor bays, dumpster pads, retail sidewalks, gum removal, building facades, and public agency facilities. Features 24/7 overnight dispatch (9:00 PM - 6:00 AM) and self-contained EPA wastewater recovery.
- [Residential Power Washing & Soft Washing](https://hygeiapowerwash.com/residential-pressure-washing.html): Driveways, aggregate concrete, travertine/flagstone patios, pool decks, stucco soft washing, redwood fences, composite decks, and garage slabs using pet- and plant-safe biodegradable detergents.
- [Curbside Trash Bin Sanitizing](https://hygeiapowerwash.com/bin-cleaning.html): Automated mobile route service arriving curbside the day after municipal trash collection. 200°F high-pressure sanitizing kills 99.9% of bacteria (E. Coli, Salmonella, Listeria), mold, and pest larvae, followed by an organic deodorizer mist.

## Pricing Structure

- **Curbside Trash Bin Monthly Subscription**: $35/month for 2 bins ($10/month for each additional bin). No long-term contracts; cancel anytime.
- **One-Time Curbside Bin Deep Clean**: $65 for 2 bins ($10 for each additional bin).
- **Commercial Power Washing**: Custom RFP / site-walk proposals based on square footage, grease load, and water reclaim requirements.
- **Residential Power Washing**: Free same-day written estimates based on square footage and surface materials.

## Certifications & Regulatory Compliance

- **DVBE Certified**: State of California Certified Disabled Veteran Business Enterprise (Certification ID: **2054658**).
- **Small Business (Micro) Certified**: State of California Department of General Services (DGS) Certified Small Business (Micro) (Certification ID: **2054658**).
- **DIR Registered Contractor**: California Department of Industrial Relations Registered Contractor (**#JS-LR-100 132 4606**) for public works and prevailing wage bids.
- **Legal Entity**: Montero Enterprises Inc. dba Hygeia Power Wash Solutions (Headquarters: 1105 Benton St, Suite A, Santa Clara, CA 95050).
- **Insurance**: $5,000,000 Commercial General Liability coverage, fully bonded and insured.
- **Environmental Compliance**: 100% compliant with California Porter-Cologne Water Quality Control Act and Federal Clean Water Act; self-contained vacuum booms and wastewater recovery holding tanks.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

- **Q: Do you service my area?**
  A: Our primary service area covers 14 Silicon Valley and Peninsula cities listed above. For neighboring Bay Area areas, contact dispatch for scheduling.
- **Q: Why should I have my trash bins professionally cleaned?**
  A: Sanitizing service begins immediately after local trash collection. We clean bins curbside right where they stand using 200°F thermal high-pressure water.
- **Q: How often should I get my bins cleaned?**
  A: Monthly cleaning is recommended for optimal odor, bacteria, and pest prevention.
- **Q: Do I need to empty my bins before you arrive?**
  A: Yes, empty bins are required. If bagged trash is placed in bins prior to arrival, our technician removes it, cleans the bin, and replaces the bag neatly inside.
- **Q: How do you clean trash bins?**
  A: We use a 200°F high-pressure system (3,000 PSI) that kills 99.9% of bacteria, washes the interior and exterior, recovers wastewater, and finishes with an organic deodorizer.
- **Q: Do I need to keep payment info on file?**
  A: Yes, recurring subscription payments are processed securely through an encrypted customer portal.
